First, the adult learner considers Water Bottle, Backpack, Rain Poncho, and Portable Charger. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers String Lights, Fireworks, Live Music, and Dance. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Magician, Face Paint, Clown, and Corn Dog. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Finally, the adult learner considers Funnel Cake, Pretzel, and Candy Apple. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. By the end, the adult learner can explain the decision clearly and use the new words in a connected response.
reading.imageBrief: Create one coherent B1-level visual for the reading about The Festival. It should support several comprehension questions, so include the main setting and 3-5 important visual details without making the scene crowded.
